description: A 17 Oct Vijesti report announced that Bobovo residents would block log removal at 09:00 on Friday 18 Oct over the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Water Management not adopting a retail wood plan and village firewood access. The saved 18 Oct follow-up search returned duplicate variants of that announcement but no post-event confirmation. This remains an announcement lead only; attendance, occurrence and state response are unresolved.
required_followup: If further permitted discovery is undertaken, seek a contemporaneous dated post-event report from an independent publisher that identifies whether and when the gathering occurred, simultaneous public attendance, and any ministry or government response. Do not infer an event or zero attendance from the absence of a confirmation in these searches.
